description: This file defines the Settings class for managing application settings in the Notesnook project, including default settings, getters, setters, and database interactions.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A class for managing application settings with persistent storage, default values, and configuration options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the settings collection in the database.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a specific setting key to a given value in the database.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific setting key, returning default if not set.

methods.name: getGroupOptions
methods.description: Gets grouping options for a specified section.

methods.name: setGroupOptions
methods.description: Sets grouping options for a specified section.

methods.name: setToolbarConfig
methods.description: Sets toolbar configuration for a specified platform.

methods.name: getToolbarConfig
methods.description: Retrieves toolbar configuration for a specified platform.

methods.name: getSideBarOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the order of sidebar items for a section.

methods.name: setSideBarOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of sidebar items for a section.

methods.name: getSideBarHiddenItems
methods.description: Retrieves hidden sidebar items for a section.

methods.name: setSideBarHiddenItems
methods.description: Sets hidden sidebar items for a section.

methods.name: setProfile
methods.description: Updates the user profile with partial data.
